invalid-image error is Chinese and retains the saved background

dark document keeps the background and formula without retained CSS or script activation
normal startup, preview, saving and document navigation request no author modules
client refuses injected old responses with nonempty CSS and enabled script consent
native document print and recovery continue to suspend the remaining background only
English pages keep readable labels and the existing language preference
all paused writes and both module paths return standard 404 for admin/member/other workspace
no unexpected runtime or HTTP errors beyond deliberate paused-endpoint probes
